correctness.rationale: For R_{d,m}=conv(0,e1,...,e_{d-1},sum e_i+m e_d), barycentric nonnegativity for integral projected height z is equivalent to all x_i>=z/m and sum x_i<=n+(d-2)z/m. Taking x_i=ceil(z/m) proves the sharp if-and-only-if section criterion (d-1)ceil(z/m)<=n+(d-2)z/m. Separating z=mq+s gives all multiples mq (0<=q<=n) and each nonzero residue s with 0<=q<=n-d+1+floor((d-2)s/m). At n0=d-1-floor((d-2)/m), s=1 is exactly the final residue to appear, and from n0 every missing height in [0,mn] is mn-(m j-s), 1<=j<=d-2-floor((d-2)s/m). The standard floor-sum over m-1 residues, including gcd(d-2,m), yields G=((d-1)(m-1)-gcd(d-2,m)+1)/2. Independent direct integer point searches matched all 90 triples for d∈{3,4,5}, m∈{2,...,7}, n∈{0,...,4}; all 550 parameter pairs (d=3..24,m=2..26) passed three post-threshold gap tests. The unrestricted theorem uses the exact barycentric and gcd identities, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: Independent finite tests of 90 direct cases and 550 profiles corroborate, but are not a proof for all dimensions.
